what: A big outlined title sits transparent at the lower left (−50px, +50px) with its text shadow lying at the upper right (100px, −100px). When its top edge reaches 80% of the screen it slides into place over .6s power2.inOut while the shadow is pulled in under the letters. A recruiting-site section title that drags its shadow in (once only)

options.on: “load” starts right after the delay without watching scroll (hero heading — original 2.5s)

from.where: shared.js .dk-shadow-in (large section titles) · index.js .mv-title (Hero, after 2.5s) — original script.js textShadow 100px -100px → 0
